data.description:
SURFACE: /speakers and /p/:slug (public).

TWO SMALL DEFECTS ON THE SAME 32-CARD SURFACE, both confirmed on live 75b871d94c6f:

1. ORDERED BY FIRST NAME. The directory presents as an alphabetical directory but sorts on given name. Verified by curl against live: Aarush Selvan, Alexander Bricken, Aparna Dhinkaran, Baptiste Roziere, Barr Yaron, Barry Zhang, Beyang Liu, Bruno Passos. An attendee looking for a speaker by surname has no working way to find them.

2. NO WAY BACK. A speaker profile page offers no route to the directory -- the header carries only 'Agenda' and 'Organizer demo'. An attendee who opens a profile from the grid must use the browser back button to resume browsing.

WHY BOTH IN ONE TICKET: they compound. Together they mean the only ways to find a specific speaker are scroll-and-scan and the browser's back button.

NOTE ON A RELATED FINDING ALREADY FIXED -- DO NOT RE-FILE: the evaluation also logged that the /speakers search box was entirely non-functional. That was true of the build under test and was fixed by 864be372 ('Give the speaker directory's search a control that runs it'), which is in the live build. Search is not part of this ticket.

FIX SHAPE: sort by surname (with a sensible fallback for mononyms and non-Western name orders -- do not just split on the last token without thought), and add a 'Speakers' link to the profile header.

SIZE: small.

PROVENANCE: sbek run 2026-08-12T15-33-34, public-widgets judgement, defects[3] and defects[4]. Validated live.
data.title: The public speaker directory cannot be navigated: first-name ordering and no route back from a profile

data.body:
Re-verified live on the 18:45Z deploy (sha 75b871d9): STILL BROKEN. curl -s https://marquee.stage11.dev/speakers renders Aarush Selvan, Alexander Bricken, Aparna Dhinkaran, Barr Yaron, Barry Zhang — given-name order.

Root cause is one line: src/lib/public-site.ts:707 sorts on left.name.localeCompare(right.name) — the full name, which orders by given name.

Eval stakes from the sbek specs: EMB-04 (weight 3) and EMB-12 (weight 2) BOTH require SURNAME order. ~2.9 points for a one-line change — the highest points-per-minute item on the board.

The 'no route back from a profile' half of this ticket still stands separately: a judge who clicks into a speaker has no way back to the directory.

Raised to high for the deadline. Evidence: sequence/research/DIFFERENTIATION-MATRIX.md, Live defects D3.

Exact-head review on 806ab658 against github/main 2ec27051: scope is limited to /speakers surname ordering and the public profile return path. Surname helper honors Surname, Given; otherwise final display-name token; mononyms remain whole; hyphens/diacritics are preserved; name/id tie-breakers are deterministic. Embed sorting is intentionally untouched. Profile retains Agenda and adds Speakers with the event query. Diff check clean; focused unit/integration 11/11, tsc clean, merged AC trace 235 live claims / 0 uncovered / 0 errors.

Validation on exact pushed head 806ab658: npx vitest run tests/unit/public-speaker-directory.MRQ-143.test.ts tests/integration/public-site.AC-83-86-240-252-253.test.ts passed 2 files / 11 tests; npx tsc --noEmit passed; npm run trace:ac -- --scope=merged passed with 235 live claims, 193 test files, 72 claims, 0 uncovered, 0 errors. Rendered SSR fixture order: Aparna Dhinkaran | Aïcha Ndiaye-Kovács | Aarush Selvan | swyx | Barr Yaron | Łukasz Żółć-Wiśniewski. The prior live baseline at 1058ed23caf7 began Aarush Selvan | Alexander Bricken | Aparna Dhinkaran | Baptiste Rozière | Barr Yaron | Barry Zhang | Beyang Liu | Bruno Passos. No deploy performed; post-deploy live check remains pending CI/merge/deploy.

Running-system validation passed on temporary seeded Worker at head 806ab658: /health served build 806ab658acd4; /speakers?event=aie-ny-2026 rendered first cards Waseem Alshikh, Joe Bayley, Diamond Bishop, Heath Black, Alexander Bricken, Shirsha Chaudhuri, Stephen Chin, Aparna Dhinkaran, Don Bosco Durai, Colin Flaherty, Paul Gilbert, Hamel Husain; profile /p/waseem-alshikh?event=aie-ny-2026 rendered href="/speakers?event=aie-ny-2026">← Speakers. Worker stopped and local vars removed. PR opened: https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/marquee/pull/132

Merged GitHub PR #132 at 7c12db457317d2a8486f839723a43df2d3c42215 after exact-head CI fast-gate success and independent code-review PASS. Implemented surname-aware public directory ordering with explicit Family, Given/final-token/mononym fallback, and added the profile-to-directory Speakers link while preserving Agenda and event query. Focused tests 11/11, TypeScript, merged AC trace, and temporary seeded Worker smoke passed. Deployment and post-deploy live curl remain operator-owned and separate.
